cohort: 623 pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection at a tertiary referral center in South India between March 1, 2020 and June 30, 2021
finding: While perinatal mortality was higher during the second wave of COVID-19 in India, pregnant women presented with more severe illness, but maternal mortality remained similar between the two waves.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was significantly higher during the first wave compared to the second wave (48% vs 32.4%).
